title: Art. 19.1 — Constitución Política de Chile, Capítulo III, Artículo 19, N°1
content: The right to life and to the physical and mental integrity of the person. The law protects the life of the one about to be born. The death penalty may only be instituted for a crime established in a law approved by a qualified quorum. The application of any illegitimate constrain is forbidden;
